title: Blue Ridge · Asheville to Linn Cove Viaduct
slogan: A 229 km loop out of Mount Mitchell
story: High forest, stone walls and America’s best slow road. 229 km round from Black Mountain - plan on about 4 h 24 of riding. It goes by way of Linville Falls, Linn Cove Viaduct and Blowing Rock. The climb of the day is Mount Mitchell. It tops out at about 950 m. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Appalachians · Tail of the Dragon and Cherohala

story: Corners, discipline and zero interest in showing off. Out of Robbinsville and back again: 202 km, roughly 3 h 53 in the saddle. The stops in between: Cherohala Skyway and Tellico Plains. Tail of the Dragon is the high point. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Appalachians · Snake and Back of the Dragon
slogan: A 430 km loop out of Shady Valley
story: Remote bends and a better reason to cross state lines. A one-way ride of 430 km, Mountain City to Mountain City - roughly 8 h 16 in the saddle. On the way it passes Tazewell, Back of the Dragon and back through Tazewell. The climb of the day is The Snake US 421. It tops out at about 850 m. It is a high-mountain day.
